info.title: Wodby 2 Public API
info.description:
Public REST API for customer SDKs and code integrations.
GraphQL remains internal for the dashboard. This contract is the versioned public surface.

get.description: Owner-only. Run a read-only Git command in the workspace runner and return the current branch, HEAD commit and uncommitted changes. When the state cannot be read, available is false and reason explains why.

200.description: Live Git state of the workspace checkout

get.description: Owner-only. Returns how one file in the workspace checkout differs from the last commit, with staged and unstaged changes together. An untracked file is shown as added. When the diff cannot be read, available is false and reason explains why.

parameters.description: Previous path of a renamed or copied file.

post.description: Owner-only. Fast-forwards the workspace checkout to its upstream branch, keeping uncommitted changes, then runs the environment's post-deployment scripts unless scripts is false.

Pause workspace. Workspace operations preserve the persistent checkout.
Resume workspace. Workspace operations preserve the persistent checkout.

post.description: Adds a message to an idle chat and starts the agent's run, which continues after the response.
